Bright, Open-Plan Living with Ocean Breezes
This 148 sqm condo on the 6th floor offers a really comfortable, modern layout that flows nicely. You’ve got a large open-plan living and dining area that feels spacious yet cozy, especially with the L-shaped sectional sofa and floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors leading out to the balcony where you can actually see the calm ocean and small boats bobbing around.
Balcony & Outdoor Space
The balcony curves gently and is partially covered with recessed lighting, making it a perfect spot to relax any time of day or evening. There’s even an outdoor jacuzzi tub with jets and headrests if you want to unwind while soaking in the sea view.
Kitchen & Dining
The kitchen is sleek and modern — stainless steel appliances, a black tiled mosaic backsplash, granite or quartz countertops, and under-cabinet lighting all add a nice touch. It’s laid out in a practical L-shape that keeps things efficient but not cramped. The connected dining area seats six at a black rectangular table, which is great if you like to entertain.
Bedrooms & Bathrooms
Both bedrooms feel spacious with high ceilings and built-in closets. The main bathroom is thoughtfully designed with a built-in bathtub featuring tiled steps, a large window with curtains, and clean, minimalist touches like black-and-white tiled floors and walls. The glass shower enclosure and modern fixtures keep it feeling fresh and airy.
Overall, the building itself has a quiet, green setting near the beach
